requirement.description: The View class's __getattr__ method incorrectly raises AttributeError when accessing layout fields that are reserved names (starting with underscore) instead of properly handling them via indexing.
requirement.contract: When accessing a field in a View that has a reserved name (starts with underscore) that exists in the layout, the __getattr__ method should raise an AttributeError indicating the field must be accessed via indexing, not attribute access.

requirement.description: The View class's __getattr__ method doesn't provide proper error messages when accessing non-existent fields, instead raising generic AttributeError without suggesting similar field names.
requirement.contract: When accessing a non-existent field in a View, __getattr__ should raise an AttributeError with a message listing available field names and suggesting similar names for typos.

requirement.description: The View class's __getitem__ method doesn't properly handle indexing with values for non-array layouts, causing TypeError when trying to index with dynamic values.
requirement.contract: When indexing a View with a Value or ValueCastable for non-array layouts, __getitem__ should raise a TypeError with appropriate message indicating only array layouts support value indexing.

requirement.description: The _AggregateMeta's __new__ method doesn't correctly handle reset value validation for Union classes with multiple reset values.
requirement.contract: When creating a Union class with multiple reset values specified for fields, the __new__ method should raise a ValueError with clear message indicating only one field can have a reset value.

requirement.description: The View class's __getattr__ method doesn't handle attribute access properly when the attribute name corresponds to a method or property of the Signal class.
requirement.contract: When accessing attributes that would conflict with Signal class methods (like 'add', 'do', 'f') on Views, the __getattr__ method should properly defer to layout-based field access instead of raising AttributeError.
